title: CoForge governance Report 2 — four analytics frames published to FigJam (project summary, agentic blueprint, competitor analysis, contract & adoption)

published_surface.boundary: ONE-WAY. Claude Design/Code to Figma has no automated diff-back. Figma now owns these four frames; editing them there will not flow back into this repository, and re-running the pipeline OVERWRITES rather than merges. The SVGs in this directory are the exact bytes imported, verified by checksum at import time.

scope: CoForge only (~/Projects/coforge), 2026-08-25 to 2026-09-08. The Hermes/Luma predecessor is a separate workflow and is deliberately NOT measured here; Report 1 on the same page reports that other body of work and was left untouched.

measurement.counting_rule: every transcript record counted once, keyed on message uuid; the four transcripts are nested forks
measurement.corroboration: The repository's own collector (validation/collect-metrics.py), repaired and self-tested independently, reports 7.12M output tokens and 2.90B cache reads for the same corpus. This board's independent count agrees within 2%; the gap is the minutes between the two runs.
measurement.pricing: Opus 5 list: $5.00/M input, $25.00/M output, cache read 0.1x input ($0.50/M), cache write 2x input at one-hour TTL ($10.00/M). Multipliers taken from the claude-api skill, not from memory. ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY — nothing was billed at these rates.

typography: CoForge only. Anek Latin carries every word (display and body — single-family by OQ-2, resolved 2026-08-27). Source Code Pro carries every number, because Anek's digits are proportional: measured in this Figma file at 28px a '1' is 40.3% narrower than a '0', and Figma has no font-variant-numeric.
open_items: brand.md records the Anek digit-width gap as 7.7% citing ART-006; measured in Figma it is 40.3%. One of the two is wrong or they measure different things. Logged for verification; it does not change the rule.
No agent holds a Figma tool (ADR-007 deferred the grant until a real file existed; it now does). This board was produced by the main session.
Neither verify-svg.mjs nor verify-frames.mjs is covered by the machinery hash — check 5g never descends into artifacts/ (recorded as W-3 in validation/attestation.json).
